 Print The IMD predicts isolated heavy rainfall in the Northeast and Andaman Islands on November 11 (Representative image) NEW DELHI: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast isolated heavy rainfall over parts of the Northeast and Andaman and Nicobar Islands on Wednesday, November 11. Thunderstorms accompanied by lightning are also likely over Bihar, Kerala and parts of the Northeast. Delhi-NCR and several parts of central and western India are expected to remain dry.  Delhi, Haryana and Chandigarh are likely to experience dry weather on Wednesday, with no significant weather activity forecast over the region. Northwest India: Rain likely in Himachal, J&K
 Isolated rainfall is likely over Jammu and Kashmir and Himachal Pradesh on November 11. The IMD has forecast isolated to scattered rainfall over Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh between November 10 and 11, while Himachal Pradesh may receive rainfall between November 10 and 15. Punjab is likely to remain dry on Wednesday, with isolated to scattered rainfall expected between November 12 and 15. Uttarakhand is also likely to experience dry weather on November 11, followed by rainfall on November 12 and 13. Also Read| Delhi AQI at 307, still 'very poor'; Chandni Chowk tops pollution chart at 395 Northeast India: Heavy rain alert in four states
 The IMD has forecast isolated heavy rainfall over Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram and Tripura on Wednesday. Thunderstorms accompanied by lightning are also likely over these states. Arunachal Pradesh, Assam and Meghalaya are likely to receive isolated to scattered rainfall between November 10 and 12. Rainfall activity is expected to continue over parts of the Northeast on Thursday. East India: Rain likely in West Bengal, Sikkim; heavy showers in Andaman
 Isolated to scattered rainfall is likely over parts of eastern India. Gangetic West Bengal, Sub-Himalayan West Bengal and Sikkim may receive scattered rainfall on Wednesday, while isolated rainfall is likely over Odisha and Jharkhand. Bihar is also likely to experience thunderstorms accompanied by lightning. The Andaman and Nicobar Islands are expected to receive fairly widespread to widespread rainfall, with isolated heavy showers likely on Wednesday. Thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds reaching 40-50kmph are also forecast over the islands. South India: Thunderstorms likely in Kerala
 Kerala and Mahe are likely to experience thunderstorms accompanied by lightning on Wednesday. The IMD has forecast isolated rainfall over parts of Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal, Coastal Andhra Pradesh and Rayalaseema. Fairly widespread to widespread rainfall is expected over Kerala and Mahe on November 15. West and Central India: Dry weather likely
 No significant weather activity is expected over most parts of central and western India during the week. Rajasthan, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Goa and Chhattisgarh are likely to remain dry. Weather outlook for the next few days
 Rainfall activity is expected to continue over the Northeast and Andaman and Nicobar Islands on November 12. The Andaman and Nicobar Islands are likely to receive isolated heavy rainfall until November 14. The IMD has also forecast fairly widespread to widespread rainfall over Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, Gilgit-Baltistan and Muzaffarabad on November 12 and 13, with isolated heavy rainfall during this period. Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal may receive isolated heavy rainfall again on November 15, while Kerala and Mahe are likely to experience fairly widespread to widespread rainfall on the same day.
